provider: Borealis (Canadian Dataverse Repository, University of Toronto / Scholars Portal)

free_tier.stated: Institutional collections are provided with between 1 TB and 10 TB of storage, with the option to increase that space as needed; non-affiliated users cannot deposit data by default.

egress.terms: Cloudflare-fronted; answered the version API in 0.77 s, the fastest of the six majors tested.

tooling: curl against /api/; same client code as Harvard
chaining: Native email registration with no explicit byte quota published in user accounts. Houses large research collections with multi-gigabyte datasets.
limits_note: No per-file or per-account figure published; no quota endpoint returns a number. Platform default applies (unlimited unless :MaxFileUploadSizeInBytes is set).
reliability_note: The repository now runs v6.12.1.3-SP, so the previously announced upgrade has shipped.
